About  /  History & Testimonials

We started with one neighbor's laptop.

How we got here

2019

A side practice

Jimi Michel starts taking evening calls from friends, neighbors, and their parents — mostly laptops, printers, and accounts nobody could get back into.

2021

Word gets around

A handful of Portland nonprofits ask for help with remote work. The pattern becomes obvious: the technology is fine, the explaining is missing.

2023

FIDDLE,GREEN

The practice becomes a company, named after the first green thing to come up in a Maine spring. Nonprofit discounts and pro bono hours are written in from day one.

2024

Beyond the laptop

Trainings, network buildouts, and advisory work follow. Meryn Robinson and Elvis Agah join as contractors so the work never outruns the quality.

2026

Public sector work

Registrations complete, we begin supporting municipal and county offices — the same approach, on a longer timeline.

In their words

References

Happy to connect you with a client whose situation looks like yours — including public sector references for procurement.

Maine technology consulting for small businesses, nonprofits, startups, and public agencies.
